name: A release update is reported once; one real HTTP failure and recovery leave the report unchanged and do not wake the watcher
A sustained HTTP failure is reported on its second sweep once, and recovery reports the pending update once
Failures on different tools never combine into a consecutive failure streak
A Git remote outage and recovery preserve its pending update without fetching or changing the watched clone
Missing tools, invalid patterns, absent directories, registry errors, and budget cuts remain immediate and outside probe streaks
A repeated real sweep-budget notice stays single and silent through one failed probe and recovery
A hung HTTPS origin obeys the probe timeout and reports only after consecutive failed sweeps
